notes: Reference phased haplotype LD, not GWAS-matched LD or conditional association.
All PASS biallelic SNVs in fixed GRCh37 region; rsID-missing and multiallelic partners are counted as excluded, not absent.
C/T restricted analysis excludes non-C/T anchor haplotypes; all-haplotype T versus non-T is separate. Small allele counts reported; no novelty or independence claim.

44207 distinct regional VCF rows, 1590 excluded non-PASS/non-biallelic SNVs, one anchor, 42616 attempted partner rows per population; attempted includes monomorphic partners, not necessarily finite r2.
Phase3 anchor only C/T, no other allele observed among CHB/JPT/CEU, so restricted and all-T-vs-nonT coincide in these panels. Ensembl C/A/T annotation is not contradicted by this reference subset.

Zero r2>=.8 proxies is conditional on the selected reference populations, biallelic PASS SNVs and GRCh37 ±500kb window; no evidence of independence or novelty. Prior empty LD API not equivalent to this calculation.

Need maximum and distribution of finite LD with nonfinite/monomorphic denominator, independent check of high correlation threshold and regional prior signals. No matched LD, formal Coloc, independent GWAS or causality.
